items.question: How do I register for the Congress?
items.answer: Visit the website and navigate to the Registration section. Complete the registration form and proceed with payment via Mercado Pago (Argentina) or PayPal (international).

items.question: What is the registration cost?
items.answer: $395 USD per person. Registration is open from 20 February 2026 until 31 March 2027. There is a cap of 75 delegates per region and 150 for the host region, with a total maximum of 600 attendees.

items.question: Are there any discounts available?
items.answer: No, there is a single standard fee of $395 USD for all participants to ensure fairness and equality.

items.question: What is the cancellation policy?
items.answer: Up to 6 months before the congress (October 2026): 80% refund. Up to 4 months before (December 2026): 50% refund. Within 2 months of the congress (February 2027): no refund.

items.question: Do I need to be a ranger to attend?
items.answer: No. The congress is open to conservation professionals, wildlife experts, researchers, policymakers, NGO representatives, and community members passionate about conservation.

items.question: How do I apply for a visa to Argentina?
items.answer: Check your visa requirements through the Argentine visa portal. Many nationalities can obtain an electronic travel authorization (AVE) online.

items.question: What languages will be used at the Congress?
items.answer: The primary language is English. Simultaneous translation to French and Spanish will be provided during plenary sessions. Volunteer translators may assist during workshops and field trips.

items.question: Is there funding available for speakers?
items.answer: Expressions of Interest forms are available in English, Spanish, and French for delegates seeking funding support.

items.question: Can my spouse or partner attend?
items.answer: Yes. Spouses and partners pay the same $395 registration fee and take a registration spot.

items.question: What does the registration with accommodation include?
items.answer: Transport to and from the airport, welcome pack, full congress access, simultaneous translations at plenaries, coffee and tea service, lunch, field trips, hotel room (18-24 April 2027), breakfast, dinner, and evening function access.

items.question: Where will accommodation be?
items.answer: The main accommodation is at Hotel Amerian Portal del Iguazu, a 5-star hotel with 117 rooms, located at Av. Tres Fronteras 780. Dates: 18-24 April 2027.

items.question: What activities are available for non-attending spouses?
items.answer: Puerto Iguazu offers numerous attractions including Iguazu Falls, bird parks, gemstone mines, and Jesuit missions. Tourist information will be available at the venue.

items.question: Where can I find more information?
items.answer: Visit the WRC website, IRF website, and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and SIGUNARA social media channels.

items.question: Are there limitations to registrations?
items.answer: Yes. Maximum 600 total attendees, 75 per region, and 150 for the host region (Argentina). Registration is individual and personal, non-transferable.

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: Argentina: Mercado Pago (ARS) or bank transfer. International: PayPal (USD). We advise avoiding American Express and Mastercard due to high fees. Bank transfer is recommended for South American delegates.

items.question: Can I volunteer at the Congress?
items.answer: Yes! We are accepting volunteers, especially multilingual individuals. Contact wrc@internationalrangers.org for more information.

items.question: How does sponsorship work?
items.answer: Sponsorship follows a tiered approach: Platinum, Gold, Silver, and Bronze. Contact us for the sponsorship prospectus in English, Spanish, or French.

items.question: Can my partner stay at the hotel without attending the congress?
items.answer: Yes. Partners can book accommodation separately at the congress hotel.

items.question: Can my partner attend the congress with me?
items.answer: Yes. Your partner pays the same $395 registration fee and can book accommodation together with you.

items.question: Can I get a private room?
items.answer: Private room options are being arranged. Contact us for more details and availability.

items.question: Can I attend without staying at the congress hotel?
items.answer: Yes, but breakfast and dinner at the venue will not be included. Evening function attendance would need to be booked separately.

items.question: Can I stay at alternative accommodation?
items.answer: Yes, alternative accommodation is available in Puerto Iguazu. However, transport and meals would be at your own expense.

items.question: Who is the IRF?
items.answer: The International Ranger Federation is a worldwide, non-profit membership-based organisation established in 1992, representing rangers across 50+ countries on 6 continents and 7 regions.

items.question: Who is SIGUNARA?
items.answer: The Syndicate of National Rangers of Argentina Republic (SIGUNARA), established in 1990, is Argentina's National Rangers union recognized by the National Government.

items.question: What is the best payment method?
items.answer: We advise avoiding American Express and Mastercard due to high international fees. Bank transfer is recommended for South American delegates.

items.question: Are donation coupons available?
items.answer: Donation options are being finalized. Please check back for updates.

items.question: What is the World Ranger Congress?
items.answer: The WRC is an initiative of the International Ranger Federation, co-hosted with a local ranger association, held every 3-4 years in a different global region.

items.question: What are the congress details?
items.answer: The 11th IRF World Ranger Congress takes place in Puerto Iguazu, Misiones, Argentina from 19-23 April 2027, with up to 600 rangers and conservation professionals.

items.question: What is the congress theme?
items.answer: "Recognising Rangers: Advancing the profession to safeguard our future" — focusing on improved working conditions, better equipment and training, and empowering rangers for biodiversity protection.

items.question: What are the congress objectives?
items.answer: Skills development, knowledge sharing, building partnerships, and finding strategic conservation ways through four key pillars: Ranger Recognition & 30x30, Ranger Experiences, Ranger Solutions, and the Ranger Declaration.

items.question: Is there an investment opportunity?
items.answer: Yes. Sponsorship tiers are available: Platinum, Gold, Silver, and Bronze. Contact us for the sponsorship prospectus.

items.question: How can I sponsor a ranger?
items.answer: Sponsor a Ranger forms are available. The estimated cost per ranger is: Registration $395, Travel ~$1,000, Accommodation ~$650.
